run_sim_finger_screenshots: run the script to launch a PyBullet screenshot viewer for a given TriFinger type
create_simfinger: create a SimFinger instance with a specific finger type and visualization enabled
get_valid_finger_types: get the list of valid finger types from finger_types_data for use as CLI choices
create_colored_cube: create a ColoredCubeV2 collision object at a given position with an Euler-rotated orientation
reset_finger_positions: reset the finger joint positions and velocities to a specified configuration tuple
